title: Intelligent Semantic Matching (ISM) for Video Tutorial Search using Transformer Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.12921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rise in the number and diversity of available software development video tutorials has enhanced digital learning for developers but also introduced challenges in locating relevant content efficiently. Existing video search methods, including keyword-based approaches and tools like CodeTube and TechTube, rely primarily on retrieval algorithms such as BM25, which fail to capture the semantic nuances and user intentions behind search queries. To address these limitations, we introduce ISM, an approach that uses SBERT to generate semantically rich vectors from video tutorial transcripts to improve the search for programming video tutorials. By segmenting transcripts and implementing a re-ranking process, ISM effectively preserves context and enhances the relevance of search results. translated_title: 基于Transformer模型的视频教程搜索智能语义匹配（ISM）
translated_abstract: 软件开发视频教程数量和多样性的增长促进了开发者的数字化学习，但同时也为高效定位相关内容带来了挑战。现有的视频搜索方法，包括基于关键词的方法以及CodeTube和TechTube等工具，主要依赖BM25等检索算法，这些算法无法捕捉搜索查询背后的语义细微差别和用户意图。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了ISM方法，该方法使用SBERT从视频教程转录文本中生成语义丰富的向量，以改进编程视频教程的搜索。通过对转录文本进行分段并实施重新排序过程，ISM有效地保留了上下文并提高了搜索结果的相关性。此外，ISM利用GPT-4生成信息丰富的视频摘要，使开发者能够快速评估视频内容的相关性。为了评估我们的方法...
tldr: 该论文提出ISM方法，利用SBERT从视频教程转录文本中生成语义向量并结合重排序机制，同时使用GPT-4生成视频摘要，从而显著改进编程视频教程的语义搜索效果。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ISM, an approach that uses SBERT to generate semantically rich vectors from video tutorial transcripts with transcript segmentation and re-ranking, combined with GPT-4-generated video summaries, to significantly improve semantic search for programming video tutorials.
